definitions.full: H5868. ayam [ עֲיָם ] noun [masculine] dubious, possibly glow (Arabic , to thirst , thirst, internal heat ), si vera lectio (so Du; on form compare Nö ZMG xxxvii (1883), 526 ); — construct רוּחוֺ בֵּעְיָם Isa 11:15 , read perhaps בְּעֹצֶם (so apparently Vrss) Thes Luzz Krochm Che Gu Kau Gr Perles Anal. 52 .
